ashby:1mind:cc9a69a9-442b-4b4a-88a4-135a.summary: This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

sections.title: 1mind is building the next generation of revenue teams.
paras: We are creating a new category of enterprise software: Autonomous Customer Experience. Our platform deploys Superhumans , go-to-market teammates with a face, a voice, and a GTM brain that serve the buyer across the entire journey with one continuous memory. They engage, demo, onboard, and support in the moments no company could ever staff, so the handoffs disappear and growth stops leaking.
Join us as we define the category and build the platform that powers the next generation of revenue teams. When the buyer wins, the company wins. Every1 Wins.

sections.title: About the role
paras: 1mind is building the AI-led GTM workforce: Superhumans that run SDR, SE, onboarding, account management and customer success work end to end, on top of a shared context graph that compounds with every customer conversation. Today each Superhuman mostly runs as a single agent on a single surface. The next product leap is orchestration: teams of agents that hand work to each other, run packaged GTM plays, and bring in humans only when the trust ladder says so.

You'll own that leap. This is the first PM seat dedicated to the agent runtime and orchestration layer. You'll work directly with the GenAI team, report to the Chief Product Officer, and decide how agents plan, call tools, share memory, hand off, and get evaluated. Then you'll turn that into a platform that other PMs, forward-deployed engineers and customers build on.

The window is short. Large platforms are consolidating the two ends of the funnel, and the live-conversation middle is still open. Expect to ship a v1 that isn't clean, then make it better every week.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Own the agent runtime every Superhuman runs on: planning, tool calling, memory reads and writes against the context graph, guardrails, and the Assist, Co-pilot and Autonomous trust ladder. One runtime, many roles.

Design multi-agent orchestration: handoffs between Superhumans across the customer journey (inbound SDR to SE Ride-Along to onboarding to CSM), shared state across a deal or account, and conflict resolution when two agents want to act on the same contact.

Turn GTM orchestrations into a product. Packaged plays by funnel-stage outcome, like qualification and activation or retention and expansion, that customers configure instead of build. You define the primitives: triggers, steps, agent assignments and human checkpoints.

Build and own the eval harness for agent behavior, including task-level success, objection-to-advance rate, escalation precision, and hallucination and tool-error rates. Set the bar that gates every release and own the dashboard that tracks it.

Define the platform surface: the APIs, configuration and admin experiences that app-layer PMs, forward-deployed engineers and enterprise admins use to compose and tune agents, including per-enterprise adapters and fine-tuning hooks.
Run a weekly ship cadence with GenAI and engineering, with enablement and customer success looped in before every release.
Write the specs engineers want to build from (data models, state machines, API shapes and the tradeoffs between them), and prototype in code or no-code tools before you write the doc.

sections.title: Required
bullets: 5+ years of product management, including at least 2 years shipping LLM-based agents to production users. You've owned a product where the model's behavior was the product.
Hands-on with the agent stack: tool calling, planning loops, memory and retrieval, multi-agent handoff patterns, and the ways each one fails. You can read a trace and tell us what went wrong.
You've built or owned an eval harness and used it to gate releases. You think in task success rates, not vibes.
Experience at an AI-native company, or on a large platform team paired with founder or early-stage startup experience, preferred. We're not looking for SaaS feature PMs.
Technical enough to spec data models, state machines and API shapes, and to explain the tradeoffs between them.
Comfortable deciding with incomplete data and shipping weekly. You'd rather fix a v1 in production than polish a v2 in a doc.
Clear writing. Your PRDs are short, your eval reports have numbers, and your Slack messages make sense to sales.

ashby:arlo:1d727d9f-0f34-4137-95de-266ad.summary:
Most of what makes American healthcare expensive isn’t medical care. It’s the machinery wrapped around it: middlemen taking a cut, fraud nobody stops, and billing systems designed to fight over payment instead of deliver care. The result is higher premiums, denied claims, surprise bills, and a system patients increasingly experience as adversarial.

Arlo is rebuilding health insurance for small businesses from first principles: making sure as much of every premium dollar as possible goes to care instead of getting absorbed by the system around it. We do that by identifying fraud earlier, steering members toward higher-quality and lower-cost care, automating operational overhead, and eliminating vendors whose business exists mostly to take a cut.

sections.title: About the role
paras: Every health insurance quote Arlo sends goes through our platform. A broker sends us a group, underwriting reviews and prices it, the broker looks over the quote, and if the group signs, we implement the plan. Sales, underwriting, account management, ops, and brokers are all in it every day.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own that platform. Right now our co-founder and CTO decides most of what the platform does next, on top of running engineering. Our technical team of 15 across product and data can build a lot, so the harder question is what’s worth building. We want someone who’ll make that call and make sure what ships is truly excellent.
You’ll plan and track the team’s work in Linear, and you’ll also ship features yourself using GitHub and Claude Code. We want you to ultimately feel ownership of the product.

sections.title: Learn the business and start shipping
bullets: Get to know how stop-loss works, who uses the platform, and what they use it for
Ship high-quality features yourself within your first month, using AI coding tools to open and merge PRs

sections.title: Build and own the roadmap
bullets: Set up how we plan product work. We don’t have a roadmap process today, so you’ll build it
Own the roadmap within your first 60 days and communicate trade-offs clearly, including telling a team when their priorities are moving down the list
Work with the Head of Engineering to decide what the team takes on next and how to balance new features against fixing what’s already there

sections.title: Find the bottlenecks and fix them
bullets: Spot problems in the product before anyone asks, figure out what’s actually causing them, and ship the fix
When sales or underwriting tells you something is broken, have a fix live within a week or two

ashby:cambium:39fa6f0c-8066-4862-bb35-a2.summary:
Cambium is a modern American wood manufacturer, distributor, and technology company connecting and modernizing the wood economy. We work with architects, builders, and leading brands across the built environment, including Amazon, Room & Board, and Equinox. Our work has been recognized by Time's Best Inventions and Fast Company's Innovation by Design Awards. Technology is how we match supply to demand across a fragmented industry.

The American hardwood industry has lost more than half its sawmills in the last two decades. Quality trees go to waste, and the US imports more lumber than it produces, even though domestic capacity could meet nearly all of our needs. Until now, this industry forced a choice: local relationships or national scale, meaningful materials or modern efficiency. We don't think those are real tradeoffs. We're building the infrastructure to prove it, with modern…

sections.title: About This Role
paras: The Mass Timber movement is a fast-growing trend in construction that builds offices, schools, and warehouses from wood instead of steel and concrete. Operators in Mass Timber place a high value on responsibly sourced wood, and that’s why several Fortune 100 companies are already buying their wood from Cambium.

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the software we use to validate and visualize sustainable sourcing practices. You’ll collaborate with our go-to-market team to unlock product-market fit and turn software into a major growth lever for the Mass Timber business unit.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own the product roadmap for the Mass Timber business unit.

Run lots of discovery. The most important part of your job is defining the problems we need to solve and uncovering the right solutions. You’ll partner with Design and Engineering to interview, experiment, ship, and iterate.
Become a domain expert. Your goal should be to be able to answer questions about Mass Timber from anyone in the business.

Drive a steady release drumbeat. We believe learning fast requires shipping fast. The Technical Program Manager owns delivery, and you’ll work closely with them to make sure their sprint map matches your roadmap.

Organize and run impactful meetings. These will be with your partners in Engineering and Design, as well as with stakeholders from across the business. Meetings are expensive, so you should take the care to plan them deliberately.
Spend time with the data. You’ll need to deeply understand the supply chain data we’ve already collected, and build the repeatable process by which we collect more.

sections.title: You May Enjoy This Role If…
bullets: You like discovery. This is where we are counting on you the most. You need to be obsessed with talking to customers, relentless about figuring out what problems to solve, and ruthlessly skeptical about whether your solutions are good enough.

You like working closely with engineering and design. We believe strongly in empowering our engineers and designers with context, and solving problems collaboratively. Your teammates should be helping shape your PRDs from the first draft.

You like defining your own surface area. We don’t know exactly what platform slices you need to own to be successful. You’ll need to help us figure that out, and you’ll need to be flexible as the business needs change over time.
You like working on go-to-market strategy. Some PM jobs don’t involve working with Sales. This isn’t one of them; Sales will depend on you to help figure out how to bring your product to market.

You believe in “strong opinions, loosely held.” Our team works through problems with lively discussion, and we encourage disagreement. We don’t care who is right; we care about finding the right answer.

sections.title: You May NOT Enjoy This Role If…
bullets: You like writing highly prescriptive specs and tickets. Your engineering teammates are counting on you to provide context and define outcomes, not to pre-solve every edge case.
You want to run Agile rituals. That job lives with our Technical Program Manager.
You prefer working on established products. You won’t be handed a blank slate, but you also won’t be getting a thriving userbase. There’s a lot of whitespace you need to fill.

You prefer working with technical audiences. We’re a lumber company. Outside of the product and engineering teams, most of your coworkers don’t have a background in the software industry. They won’t know your jargon or use your frameworks; you’ll need to learn theirs.

sections.title: The Work

Speed is one of the core traits we look for: how fast you learn, how fast your thinking evolves, and how fast you execute. The AI agent industry changes by the month, and the product has to move with it.

bullets: Deliver dramatically differentiated products. Ship products and solutions that are clearly ahead of the alternatives and lead the industry.
Own product outcomes. Own the roadmap and success metrics for your part of AEI, and contribute to the wider vision and strategy.

Win with customers. Work with enterprise agent teams every week, turn what you learn into sharp product bets, and support proofs of concept and early deployments through to real improvements in their agents.
Define what agent effectiveness means in practice. Help shape the metrics, dimensions and workflows that agent teams use day to day to find where their agents fall short and why.
Build to think. Use AI tools to prototype ideas, analyze real agent data and validate direction with working artifacts before asking engineering to build.

greenhouse:gomotive:8909273002.summary:
Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Motive is hiring a Customer Marketing Specialist to own and execute our reviews program and customer content operations. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role focused on driving measurable brand credibility through review platform performance, content enablement, and customer proof point management.

You'll work at the intersection of customer advocacy and go-to-market execution, partnering closely with our digital marketing team to increase Motive's search visibility and ensure our customer voice is showing up where buyers are already looking. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, and motivated by seeing their work directly influence pipeline and competitive positioning.
You'll use AI, automation, and modern customer marketing tools to make review generation and content operations more scalable, while ensuring every customer touchpoint is polished and positive.

sections.title: Reviews Program Ownership
bullets: Own Motive's day-to-day presence on G2, TrustRadius, TrustPilot, Capterra, and Gartner Peer Insights.
Run review generation campaigns end-to-end, including customer targeting, outreach sequencing, incentivization, and follow-up.
Deliver a quarterly G2 content plan and enablement package to internal stakeholders following each reporting cycle.
Partner with the AEO team to align review strategy with search visibility goals and ensure review content supports organic discoverability.
Track review volume, ratings trends, and competitive benchmarks, surfacing insights and risks to leadership on a regular cadence.
Coordinate internally on review response workflows and flag feedback patterns to CS and Product.

sections.title: Customer Content & Asset Management
bullets: Conceptualize and execute innovative customer content strategies to drive engagement and conversion.
Coordinate customer outreach, scheduling, approvals, and consent for all advocacy content and testimonial activities when needed.
Maintain a clean, well-tagged, and easily accessible repository of customer proof points for Sales and Marketing use.
Ensure all customer content stays current, accurate, and activated across the business.

sections.title: Program Execution & Operations
bullets: Manage timelines, logistics, follow-ups, and asset delivery across all programs this role owns.
Build and maintain documentation, trackers, and workflows that keep advocacy operations organized and visible to cross-functional partners.
Ensure every customer-facing experience, from first outreach to final delivery, is timely, thoughtful, and reflects well on Motive.
Partner with Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to surface advocacy candidates and keep the content pipeline moving.

To facilitate that work, GA maintains a detailed database on more than 20 million active, left-leaning American donors, including data on net worth, ideological preferences, political donation history, non-profit donation history, demographics, and contact information. Our overall mission is to use that data to amplify forward-thinking voices, causes, and people.

sections.title: Job Description
paras: Grassroots Analytics is seeking a mission-driven go-getter who is interested in helping nonprofits reach their full potential using our suite of industry-leading data products.
This role is ideal for someone passionate about progressive causes and who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.

Apply knowledge of nonprofit industry trends to recommend services and strategy aligned with client goals and revenue targets.
Monitor client ROI and maintain engagement through regular follow-ups and performance check-ins.
Use project management systems to track client status, communications, and deliverables across teams.

sections.title: Targeting & Engaging Clients (20%)

Identify and attend conferences, sponsorship opportunities, and sector events to increase brand visibility.
Develop and present sales decks and proposals tailored to client needs.

sections.title: Converting Interest to Sales (20%)

Clearly communicate the value of data-driven fundraising solutions.

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

sections.title: About Gusto

sections.title: By the Numbers:
bullets: Named #1 best software for small business of 2024 by G2
2,700+ employees in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and Turkiye and growing
Over $500M in annual revenue
The SMB market is large (and growing!) with huge opportunities for Gusto to make an incredible impact for SMBs
There are 6.2M employers in the US, 98% have fewer than 100 employees (1)
550,000 new businesses are created each year in the US (1)

sections.title: What Product Management is like at Gusto:
bullets: Our Product team is lean, which means you’ll have a high degree of impact and ownership. We believe in smaller, empowered teams that move quickly with less overhead. You’ll move fast by pairing sharp product judgment with fluency in AI tools, automating what slows teams down and amplifying what makes them creative and high-performing.

We’re boundaryless builders. Lines between roles are intentionally blurred, and our PMs do whatever it takes to deliver outcomes. You’ll prototype, automate, design, and ship, using AI as your co-builder to turn problems into durable solutions that deliver customer value with urgency and care.

We’re here to serve small and medium businesses. Gusto has a strong mission-driven culture, and we care deeply about lifting up these business owners, building technology for an AI-first world that gives them the superpowers to run and grow their businesses with confidence.

We’re comfortable with change. Our environment moves fast, and PMs here thrive in ambiguity, blending curiosity, experimentation, and AI-native craft to shape how products (and work itself) are built at Gusto.

sections.title: About the Team:
paras: HR Experiences (HRX) builds the products that help small businesses hire, onboard, develop, and stay compliant: hiring and I-9s, performance, handbooks, training, labor law posters, and the tools our HR Partners use to serve their clients. Most of our customers are a department of one, an owner or office manager making consequential people decisions with no HR team to check their work.

Today we serve those customers mostly through software built in the GUI era: prescribed workflows and screens that customers have to learn, with human HR experts and advisory experiences for a growing set of them. For a meaningful segment, learning our workflows is not a must-have, and a GUI can never cover the long tail of needs that hundreds of thousands of businesses have. The opportunity ahead of us is to rebuild how HR gets delivered so that the product does the work and carries the judgment of an expert, and to make it AI-native from the start rather than a chat box bolted onto a GUI.

As Principal Product Manager, you'll be a senior individual contributor who owns the People Page experience and sets the experience direction for the HR Suite. You'll also own Training, which is where you'll build and learn quickly. You'll work hand in hand with the PM who owns the other verticals (Hiring, Onboarding, and Performance).

sections.title: About the Role:
paras: A deep technical seat in Solutions Engineering: API and integration architecture, enterprise deal qualification, and the standing partnership with Engineering and Product. You're the single owner for qualification and demo strategy on the highest-MRR, highest-leverage deals, and the escalation point when a teammate hits a genuine product or integration gap rather than a configuration issue. The role spans every route to market, but most people anchor one. Today those split between Gusto Pro and Mid-Market/Franchises/Channel Partnerships. You also set the technical standard for the broader team, mentoring reps as they grow into more senior technical scope.

sections.title: Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:
bullets: Own deep technical scoping and all enterprise requests — sole owner of qualification and demo strategy for the most complex opportunities.
Take the genuine product or integration escalations teammates surface — with reproduction steps and technical context already in hand — and own the resolution path end-to-end.
Hold a standing partnership with Engineering and Product: surface tooling gaps, feed customer/technical insight into the roadmap, and influence what gets built next.
Act as SE-side partner in PLO (premium/large-opportunity) management.
Set the technical standard for the team — coach on deal strategy, complex customer handling, and long-term technical resolution; train new hires and support continuous learning.

Own the delivery path on every scoped build. Route the work to the right resource, internal or external, hold the timeline, and own the commitment we made to the customer even when you are not the one writing the code.

Architect and validate integration/API solutions spanning multiple systems — GL mapping, time-tracking stacks, multi-state payroll, and third-party integrations — where the standard playbook doesn't apply.

sections.title: Here’s what we're looking for:
bullets: Bachelor's Degree or 7+ years of relevant work experience in a comparable senior technical, solutions-architecture, or implementation role.
Deep fluency in Salesforce (or a comparable CRM) and Gusto's integration stack — able to diagnose root cause across systems, not just within one.
Proven ability to scope and resolve genuinely ambiguous technical/API problems, and to tell a real product gap apart from everything downstream of it.
Track record of designing and implementing complex, integration-heavy solutions for enterprise-level customers.
Comfort operating as the technical point of contact directly with Engineering and Product, including writing escalations that hold up as real bug reports.
Demonstrated mentorship — able to set the technical bar for a broader team, not just clear your own queue.

greenhouse:homelight:8008777.summary:
We’re building the future of real estate — today.

HomeLight is the real estate technology platform powering innovative transactions for top agents, lenders, and their clients. Our technology makes it easier to buy and sell homes, whether that's enabling clients to buy before they sell, find a top agent, or have certainty through a modern closing process. Each year, HomeLight facilitates billions of dollars of residential real estate business on its platform for thousands of agents and loan officers. Our vision is a world where every real estate transaction is simple, certain, and satisfying for all.

Our team breaks barriers every day while staying committed to HomeLight's goals and core values , which is a crucial element to our shared success.

sections.title: Who You Are
paras: We’re looking for an intellectually curious and highly adaptable Product Manager to lead key initiatives at HomeLight focused on agent experience, consumer engagement, and AI innovation. In this role, you’ll work on both sides of our platform—building internal tools to empower real estate agents and optimizing the consumer journey to drive engagement and conversion.

You’ll shape both the consumer and agent-facing sides of a platform used across thousands of real estate transactions. You’ll collaborate with humble, high-caliber teammates who care deeply about users and outcomes. And you’ll work on meaningful, high-visibility projects that directly impact revenue and experience.

You’ll lead fast-paced product development across AI-driven coaching, nurture tools, and website conversion funnels. Your work will directly influence how consumers discover, engage, and transact on our platform, while helping agents operate more efficiently and effectively.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Own the roadmap for AI-powered agent enablement tools and consumer-facing product experiences.
Improve agent performance with internal tools for coaching, follow-up, and lead nurture.
Drive consumer conversion across key website pages and user flows using A/B testing, funnel optimization, and insights from behavioral data.
Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, customer success, marketing, and analytics to ship high-impact product experiences.
Identify pain points in the client journey and develop solutions that improve communication and collaboration between agents, consumers, and partners.
Leverage experimentation, user research, and data to iterate quickly and validate assumptions.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of our business model by identifying new opportunities for product differentiation and growth.

sections.title: What We’re Looking For
bullets: 3-5 years of product management experience, ideally in high-growth tech or SaaS environments.
Strong product instincts, fast thinking, and a bias for action.
Comfortable working in ambiguity and iterating quickly in response to feedback.
Coachable with intellectual humility and a collaborative mindset.
Experience optimizing conversion funnels, leading A/B tests, or improving digital consumer journeys.
Passion for AI and its practical applications—prior AI experience is a plus, but not required.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

sections.title: Instacart is a Flex First team
paras: There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

sections.title: Why this role is on the menu
paras: Join Instacart Insights as a Senior Manager of Customer Success. We are searching for an experienced CS leader with deep CPG and retail expertise to drive customer value delivery and satisfaction with Instacart Insights' pioneering SaaS solutions. As a senior leader within the Customer Success organization, you will play a pivotal role in building the future of our commercial organization. You will oversee a team of Managers and Customer Success Managers focused on CPG brands of all sizes, coaching them through the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding and micro-testing to data-driven insights and scaled rollout of optimal topline revenue strategies. This is an opportunity to shape how a world-class Customer Success team operates while experiencing first-hand the excitement of introducing novel, demonstrably superior capabilities to transform the market.

sections.title: What you'll cook up in your first year
bullets: Shape the future Customer Success organization as it rapidly scales. Partner closely with the Director, CS and cross-functional leaders to standardize processes, build playbooks, and establish best practices across the broader organization.

Manage key customer relationships as a senior point of contact for a portfolio of complex, multi-stakeholder accounts, driving engagement and satisfaction with our SaaS solutions, successful renewals, and business expansions.

Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder customer relationships with consistently high satisfaction and renewal rates
Deep expertise in CPG and/or Retail verticals, including a strong understanding of trade promotion, consumer insights, and merchandising dynamics
Demonstrated ability to translate complex customer needs into actionable strategies for your team and the broader organization
Strong analytical background, including data analysis and synthesis into compelling presentations and executive-level narratives
Experience developing business processes and best practices in fast-paced, high-growth environments
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior executives and multi-stakeholder audiences

greenhouse:interdependence:5471330008.summary:
The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month.

Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for, and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result.

Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment.

sections.title: WHO WE ARE
paras: We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us.

sections.title: THE ROLE
paras: Interdependence is seeking an experienced and dynamic Senior Account Director to join our Healthcare team. The Senior Account Director will play a critical role in developing and executing comprehensive public relations strategies for our healthcare and pharmaceutical clients. This individual will be responsible for managing client relationships, leading account teams, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality PR campaigns.

sections.title: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
bullets: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, building and maintaining strong relationships, understanding their business objectives, and providing strategic counsel.
Develop and implement innovative PR strategies that align with clients' business goals, leveraging industry insights and best practices.
Lead and mentor account teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment while providing guidance and support to junior staff.
Oversee the execution of PR campaigns, ensuring timely delivery of projects, high-quality work, and measurable results.
Manage client budgets and resources effectively, including staffing decisions and annual planning.
Develop and maintain relationships with key media contacts in the healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors.
Secure media coverage and manage media inquiries on behalf of clients.
Oversee the development of compelling content, including press releases, articles, case studies, and social media posts.

sections.title: QUALIFICATIONS
bullets: Minimum of 12 years of PR experience, with the majority in an agency setting.
At least 7 years in a team leadership role, including budget and staffing responsibilities.
Proven experience managing and mentoring teams, conducting annual reviews, and identifying skills gaps.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including AP writing standards and high-level media pitching.
Deep understanding of the healthcare/pharmaceutical media landscape, including FDA approvals and regulations.
Established media contacts and a track record of securing top-tier media coverage.
Strong client service and relationship-building abilities, with the skill to coach and influence the C-suite.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

greenhouse:ionq:6134775004.summary:
IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are…

sections.title: About IonQ:
paras:
Location: Bothell, US
Travel: Up to 25% domestic and international travel
Job ID: 1772

We’re looking for a customer-obsessed Product Manager to own one of IonQ’s most important and fastest-evolving experiences: what it’s like for a customer to bring an IonQ quantum computing system into their own facilities and put it to work. Within IonQ’s Compute Product team, you’ll treat on-premises deployment as a product: You’ll define what a great deployment experience looks like for our customers, and build the tools, standards and customer-facing experiences that make it repeatable, predictable and enterprise-grade as we scale.

Today, deploying a quantum computer means site requirements, facility build-outs, installation, commissioning and handover, coordinated across many teams and customers. You’ll go deep on key customer requirements along that journey, decide which challenges matter most, and work cross-functionally to drive the product solutions that solve them.
bullets: Own key components of the deployment experience end to end. Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for how customers experience key parts of the deployment journey.

Discover and prioritize customer needs. Work hands-on with customer deployments, engage directly with customers and internal teams, and turn what you learn into clear priorities. Write clear product requirements for customer-facing tools and digital experiences, and for our systems themselves where deployability depends on design.

Define what great looks like, and measure it. Set the success criteria and metrics that guide the deployment experience, such as predictability, time to value and customer satisfaction, and use them to drive decisions.
Lead through influence. Align cross-functionally with highly technical stakeholders, such as engineering, science, manufacturing, and operations teams around a shared product direction.
Represent the customer’s voice. Continuously bring deployment insights into IonQ’s broader product roadmap, including for next-generation systems, as part of a feedback loop.

10+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years in product management for technical B2B, hardware, deep-tech or otherwise complex systems products
A track record of owning products end to end: defining vision and strategy, setting priorities and roadmaps, and shipping outcomes that measurably improved the customer experience
Demonstrated skill in customer discovery and in turning complex, ambiguous customer needs into clear product requirements that technical teams can act on
Experience defining success metrics and using data and customer feedback to make product decisions
Proven ability to lead through influence and align highly technical, cross-functional stakeholders around a shared product direction
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining complex technical topics to technical and non-technical audiences, executives among them

sections.title: From the job description
paras: Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Kapitus’ recruiting process in general should email recruiting@kapitus.com
Are you a transformative product leader who thrives on building seamless, high-impact financial ecosystems?

At Kapitus, we understand that our work isn't done when a deal closes—it’s just beginning. We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Director of Product to lead the product vision and delivery for our post-funding experiences, encompassing treasury, payment strategies, customer service, and collections functions.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between strategic treasury management and thoughtful asset recovery. This is not a maintenance role; it is a high-visibility opportunity to pioneer digital transformation, integrate AI, and scale our operational capabilities in a highly competitive market.
bullets: Drive Strategic Transformation: Partner closely with leaders across Product, Finance, Treasury, Accounting, Collections, Customer Service, and Legal to identify and introduce enhancements that fundamentally advance Kapitus's operational and financial capabilities.

End-to-End Product Ownership: Take full ownership of product initiatives—from feature definition, build-vs-buy assessments, and vendor integration to execution planning, change management, and post-launch optimization.

Navigate & Capitalize on Ambiguity: Champion continuous discovery to understand customer behavior, market trends, and emerging financial innovations. Translate complex, ambiguous business needs and technologies into a clear, prioritized product roadmap.

Deliver Measurable Value: Set the standard for success by defining and monitoring key product metrics. Gather user feedback, evaluate performance, and pivot strategies nimbly to maximize business value and user satisfaction.
Ensure Compliance & Security: Keep Kapitus ahead of the curve by ensuring all financial products and requirements strictly adhere to industry standards and financial regulations.
Experience: 7–10+ years of robust product management experience, with at least 3 years in a leadership/people management role within Fintech, Payments, or Small Business (SMB) Lending.

People Leadership: Committed to people and team development. Mentor, coach and guide Product Owners in pursuit of individual and organizational goals. You empower team members to operate independently, but remain ready to roll-up your sleeves alongside the team when necessary.

Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of complex payment workflows, including orchestration, authorization, settlement, exception handling and controls. You have a working knowledge of payment rails and experience owning product requirements for payment infrastructure. Familiarity with cash/liquidity management and collections workflows.

greenhouse:lattice:8841944002.summary:
We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of Lattice Engagement and help define what great employee listening looks like in the years ahead.

Employee listening is a critical way HR leaders understand their organizations, build trust with employees, and turn feedback into action. As expectations for listening evolve, Lattice has an opportunity to make Engagement a more strategic, intelligent, and indispensable part of how companies lead.

You’ll create the long-term strategy for Lattice Engagement and lead the first major iteration of that strategy from discovery through launch. You’ll join a cross-functional team ready to execute, and together you’ll build products that give HR leaders a clearer understanding of their people—and the confidence to act on what they learn.

sections.title: What You Will Do
paras: If you enjoy solving meaningful customer problems, developing a strong point of view, and turning strategy into high-impact products, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for Engagement, you will:
bullets: Own the Engagement and employee-listening strategy. Define not only what we build next, but what the future of employee listening should mean for Lattice and the HR leaders we serve.
Turn insight into action. Develop product experiences that help HR leaders gather meaningful feedback, understand what it reveals, and take action that improves the employee experience.
Lead strategy. Drive discovery, prioritization, execution, launch, and iteration for the products that bring this vision to life.
Build a deep understanding of customers. Partner with Research to understand the needs, workflows, and most important decisions of HR leaders, and use those insights to guide the roadmap.
Partner closely with Engineering and Design. Translate customer problems and product strategy into clear, high-quality experiences that customers will want to use.
Use data to sharpen decisions. Work with Data Science to identify opportunities, measure outcomes, and continually improve the product.
Drive go-to-market readiness. Partner with Product Marketing to shape positioning, launches, and customer communication.
Own outcomes. Set and influence the key results that show Engagement is creating value for customers and for Lattice.

sections.title: What You Will Bring to the Table
paras: We’re looking for a product manager with the strategic instincts, customer empathy, and employee-listening expertise to shape the next generation of Lattice Engagement. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:
bullets: 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.
Direct experience with employee engagement, surveys, employee listening, feedback, research, or insight products.
A clear and informed point of view on the future of employee listening, including how product innovation can help organizations better understand and respond to their people.
A track record of taking ambiguous, high-impact product problems from strategy through execution and measurable customer outcomes.
Deep customer empathy and an ability to understand the priorities and challenges of HR leaders.
Strong product judgment: you can balance a compelling long-term vision with the practical decisions required to ship meaningful work now.
Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, especially with Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science, and Product Marketing.
A bias for action and the ability to create clarity and momentum in an evolving space.

sections.title: Bonus:
paras: If you have strong experience in employee listening, survey products, or adjacent customer-insight domains—even if you do not meet every preferred qualification—we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for a strong product thinker with a meaningful perspective on the future of employee listening, not a perfect resume.

Location Requirement:
This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada. At this time, we are only able to hire employees residing in these provinces.
The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $135,000 - $180,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans.
bullets: Experience building products for HR, people teams, or other complex organizational workflows.

The Salt Security Agentic Security Platform secures the full agentic ecosystem, discovering all agents, MCP connections, and APIs, stopping attacks in real time, and eliminating vulnerabilities before they reach production. Salt Security was founded in 2016 and is backed by Sequoia Capital, S Capital, Tenaya Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Advent International, and other leading investors. For more information, visit salt.security.

You will identify opportunities to expand Salt's footprint across API Security and AI Agent Security while partnering with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Product, and Channel teams to maximize customer value and account growth.

sections.title: About Stripe
paras: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

sections.title: About the team
paras: Partner Solutions Engineering sits within Global Partnerships at the intersection of Stripe’s Product and Engineering teams and the partners that extend Stripe’s platform. We own the partner-side technical outcome for selected partnership work, from architecture and implementation through testing, launch readiness, and production support.

The Ecosystem Partner Solutions Engineering team helps partners build high-quality integrations across Stripe’s app and developer-platform ecosystem. We work across areas such as developer tools, commerce, billing, automation, and data, while helping Stripe turn recurring partner needs into stronger products and reusable integration paths.

Our work has two forms. We deliver priority partner implementations, and we turn the lessons from those implementations into Product feedback, reference architectures, testing and certification paths, and reusable guidance. This allows Stripe to support more partners without treating every implementation as a bespoke project.

sections.title: What you’ll do
paras: As a Partner Solutions Engineer, Ecosystem, you will own the technical outcome for a portfolio of ecosystem areas and priority partner integrations. You will work directly with partners, Partner Development Managers, Product Managers, and Engineers to move opportunities from technical discovery through implementation and launch.

You will also develop deep expertise in selected parts of Stripe’s app and developer platform. You will identify recurring technical barriers, help Product teams distinguish isolated partner requests from broader platform needs, and create reusable paths that improve the next partner’s experience.

This is a hands-on, partner-facing engineering role. The strongest candidates can move comfortably between partner architecture, API and code-level debugging, Product feedback, delivery planning, and executive communication.

greenhouse:tegnainc:5216389007.summary:
TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

TEGNA, a leading local media company, is looking for a technical Product Manager to manage the bidding and forecasting systems within our ad tech platform. These systems answer two questions on every request: What should we bid on this impression? What can we deliver against this plan? Your goal will be to make those two answers agree, so what we forecast is what we deliver.

sections.title: About TEGNA
paras: Our bidder covers national scale and executes locally for our clients, with stations in 64 markets and delivery well beyond them, which puts these systems underneath every campaign we plan and execute. We emphasize how bidding and forecasting tie together over depth in any single channel, focusing on whether the number we quote is the number we deliver.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
paras: These are some of the areas that you can expect to work in, but not exclusive
bullets: Bidding Roadmap: Define where we invest in bidding capability next, and whether we build or buy.
Forecasting Roadmap: Define what planning and sales can promise a client before a campaign runs.
Thought Leadership: Set the standard for how we evaluate auction and pricing decisions, and advise planning and sales on what the platform supports.
Bid Logic: Own bid logic, bid shading, and pacing across CTV, video, display, and audio.
Tie-Out: Keep bid behavior and forecast output consistent, so a quoted number and a delivered number describe the same campaign.
Avails and Forecasting: Own avails, reach, and frequency forecasting for standard and custom targeting, and publish accuracy against delivered actuals.
Planning and Execution Experience: Give planners and traders a number they can commit to, and the tools to see when it moves.
Applied AI: Own the models behind bid optimization, dynamic floor pricing, and forecast generation, and the experiments that prove a change worked in live traffic.

sections.title: Required Experience and Skills
bullets: Auction mechanics. First and second price dynamics, bid shading, and pacing.
OpenRTB and supply path economics, including what a bid request costs to process.
Forecasting methods, and the reasons a forecast diverges from delivery.
SQL and log analysis, enough to answer a delivery question without opening a ticket.
Inventory quality and sell-side yield strategy are a plus.
5+ years of product management, with at least 3 at a DSP, SSP, exchange, or bidder.
Hands-on technical work in at least one of CTV, video, or display. Audio is a plus.
Shipped a change to a bidding or forecasting model, designed the test that proved it worked, and can state win rate or accuracy before and after.

From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

sections.title: The Role
paras: You will own go-to-market for Telnyx's AI Compute products: inference, embeddings, AI Gateway and the GPU infrastructure beneath them. Telnyx runs inference on its own NVIDIA GPUs inside its private global network and ships new compute products and models every month. You'll turn that cadence into positioning, launches, public benchmarks and sales enablement that win ML platform teams and voice-AI builders, working day to day with product, engineering, sales and demand generation. This is a senior individual-contributor role with full ownership of a product line, on a marketing team that runs on code and agents rather than SaaS: you'll improve on PMM workflows and always look to automate parts of the job.

sections.title: What you'll own
paras: You'll own the full AI Compute line: inference (serverless and dedicated GPU), embeddings, AI Gateway and Decision Models. Your buyers are ML platform teams, inference buyers, and voice-AI builders choosing a speech stack. The story you'll tell is that performance is a function of the network and the hardware: Telnyx is carrier-native, runs on its own GPUs, and adds no cloud margin to every token.

You'll prove that story through public latency and quality benchmarks, inference economics and TCO, and competitive campaigns against hosted-inference and speech providers. Success is measured by inference consumption, dedicated GPU contract value, and pipeline attributed to compute launches and campaigns.

bullets: Own positioning and messaging for every AI Compute product, from the model catalogue to dedicated GPU contracts, and keep it consistent across web, sales decks, docs and campaigns.
Run launches end to end: tiering, launch brief , product update emails, web pages, enablement, and the post-launch read-out on activation and pipeline.

Lead the benchmarking program as a marketing asset: decide which latency, quality and cost comparisons to publish, work with engineering on methodology, and turn results into pages, blogs and sales proof points.
Build the inference economics story: T CO and savings calculators, pricing narrative versus hyperscalers and hosted-inference providers, and the competitive battlecards behind it.
Partner with demand generation on compute campaigns (competitive, webinar series, paid) by owning the brief , the ICP , the offer and the conversion path.
Design product-activation and ICP-based lifecycle email for compute users with sales, and hand the build to the G TM engineering team.
Enable sales: battlecards, one-pagers, objection handling, sales labs and the pricing and competitor data AEs and BDRs rely on.
Maintain the competitive map for inference and speech (hosted-inference providers, speech vendors, hyperscaler AI services) and feed it into roadmap conversations with product.

Partner with source system owners. Engage owners across HRIS, scheduling, and clinical systems as a thought partner on the configuration and schema decisions that affect downstream data quality and usability.

This newly established role will focus on improving the customer experience across onboarding, adoption, education, and ongoing engagement. Our customer journey, segmentation, and coverage model have been defined. The opportunity now is to scale these foundations through consistent, proactive programs that help customers realize value throughout their relationship with us.

We have seen the impact of earlier customer engagement, improved visibility into customer health, and proactive intervention. This leader will build on what is working, creating programs that allow us to reach more customers consistently without relying solely on manual efforts.

lever:xsolla:e2339928-2061-414f-9a9b-b14.summary:
The Xsolla Offerwall puts rewarded offers in front of players inside the games and apps of our publishers. A player opens the wall, picks an offer, completes it, and earns in-game currency. Whether they do depends on what they see: the offer card, the creative, the video, the playable, and the reward moment.

Those units come from several places. Some are native offers we render ourselves. Some arrive as VAST video, HTML or MRAID creatives, or OpenRTB Native assets from demand partners. Each format has its own rules, and each one has to look right in a publisher's game, on a phone, without breaking what the advertiser sent.

sections.title: ABOUT YOU
paras: You'll own how offerwall ads look and perform. You'll decide which formats we support and how they render. You'll design what the player sees, and turn that into specs engineers can build from. You'll measure whether a change made players more likely to engage, and you'll use AI to make better creative faster than a manual process allows.

sections.title: Ad experience and creative
bullets: Own the look and feel of every ad unit in the offerwall: offer cards, detail pages, video, playables, interstitials, and the reward flow.
Set creative standards for advertisers and publishers: layouts, asset specs, safe areas, aspect ratios, and branding rules.
Balance three groups who want different things: players want a clean experience, publishers want it to match their game, and advertisers want their brand shown properly.

sections.title: oRTB formats and rendering
bullets: Define how we support VAST, HTML and MRAID , and OpenRTB Native inside the offerwall, across Web, iOS, Android, and Unity.
Write the requirements for format support: which VAST events we track, which MRAID calls we allow, and how Native assets map into our own templates.
Work with Engineering on creative QA and rejection rules, so broken or non-compliant creatives get caught before a player sees them.

sections.title: Design to engineering
bullets: Turn ideas into Figma designs and prototypes that engineers can build without guessing.
Write PRDs and acceptance criteria that cover states, edge cases, and device differences, not just the happy path.
Work with our designers on the offerwall's design system, and keep it consistent across publishers and platforms.

smartrecruiters:vuoriinc:744000159228089.summary:
As AI Product Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining Vuori's AI product roadmap and seeing AI capabilities through successful delivery. Working closely with AI engineers, business stakeholders, and design, you will keep the team focused on the right problems, ensure requirements are clear and actionable, and track progress from concept to production.

This role is well suited for a product practitioner who is energized by the day-to-day of shipping AI, someone who thrives on translating stakeholder needs into crisp requirements, removing blockers so teams can move fast, and staying close to outcomes to know when something is truly working for users and the business.

sections.title: What you'll get to do:
bullets: Keep the AI product roadmap current, well-sequenced, and visible to stakeholders — reflecting business priorities, engineering capacity, and what is actually being built.
Work with business and technology leaders to surface AI opportunities, assess their value, and bring them into the roadmap through a structured prioritization process.
Facilitate trade-off conversations between stakeholders and engineering teams, helping the group land on decisions that balance impact, feasibility, and timing.
Communicate roadmap changes, sequencing decisions, and delivery status clearly and on a regular cadence, so stakeholders are never surprised.
Flag risks and dependencies early, so teams have time to adapt before they become blockers.
Translate business needs and user requirements into clear, detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and design can act on.
Work alongside AI engineers throughout delivery — answering questions, clarifying scope, reviewing work in progress, and making fast, informed decisions when scope needs to change.
Participate in agile ceremonies and rituals — sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives — that keep cross-functional teams aligned and moving forward.

sections.title: Who you are:
bullets: Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent years of experience preferred.
5+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years working on AI, machine learning, or data-driven products shipped to real users in production environments.
Demonstrated track record of managing a product roadmap and delivering features end to end, with measurable business outcomes.
Strong ability to listen to stakeholders and users and translate their needs into clear, actionable product requirements.
Solid working knowledge of AI and ML concepts — enough to have substantive conversations with engineers and make grounded trade-off decisions.
Experience tracking and reporting on the performance of AI products, including both technical and business success metrics.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adjust for engineering, design, business, and executive audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and a consistent bias toward action, with strong organizational and follow-through skills.
